verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI app-building platform, but nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items at once. Background tasks (replit-docs-39, -48) split one project's work into parallel threads, scheduled routines (replit-docs-49) are recurring jobs, and the MCP server (replit-docs-42) manages apps one at a time. These are adjacent features, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
